variants.name: Pulse 04 — Vector
variants.label: PULSE 04 / VECTOR
variants.description: Scherpe technische letters, diepblauw en lime. Verspringende pixelbanen en een strakke, asymmetrische indeling geven deze richting veel snelheid.
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a complete landscape 1536x1024 brand identity moodboard for revive. Input image is the selected Pulse/Flow reference: use its full branding scope and integrated R idea, but this is a NEW creative direction, not a recolour of its grid.
Requirements: FAST, confident fintech, distinctive SQUARE PIXELS and forward-moving particle trails. NO cars, wheels, racetracks, roads, motorsport photos, healthcare or soft wellness styling. Photos show real business owners/advisers discussing financing or working in an active business, with laptops/documents and confident capable energy.
Integrated wordmark must be exactly SIX letters: custom R as first letter, immediately followed by evive. Same visible body height, baseline, weight and slant, normal letter spacing. No [R] + revive, no extra r, no capital. Recognisable R bowl AND lower-right diagonal leg. Reproduce the same custom R across every full wordmark, icon, mono/reversed specimen and application. Crisp readable solid logo even where backgrounds dissolve into pixels.
Show ALL brand aspects: large logo; isolated icon and mono/reverse; colour palette with hex labels; supporting GT Eesti Display typography; distinct graphic-shape/pixel system and flat counterpart; coherent simple functional icons; three-step financing process; campaign and human business photography; credible desktop website, mobile app and printed proposal. New layouts, photos, shapes and logo styles should make this a broader new direction. Contemporary designer editorial art direction, precise hierarchy, legible text, realistic device and print mockups.
Keep BOTH exact original slogans prominently:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."
No additional marketing copy, slogans or claims. In particular no "Financing momentum" or "Sneller verder samen". Other text only concept title, brand name, colour names/hex codes and short functional labels: Logo, Woordmerk, Kleuren, GT Eesti Display, Light, Regular, Medium, Bold, Aa, 0123456789, Grafische elementen, Iconen, Proces, Aanvraag ontvangen, In beoordeling, Volgende stap, Fotografie, Website, App, Voorstel, Je aanvraag, Contactpersoon, Bekijk aanvraag.
Supporting text uses GT Eesti Display visual reference from source; independent custom logo lettering is allowed.
Title "PULSE 04 / VECTOR".
Logo: bold squared technical italic sans, 14-degree lean, rectangular e counters, clipped diagonal inner corners, compact integrated R with stepped parallel channel and clear leg. Distinctly engineered, strong, medium-wide, no decorative stencil gaps.
Palette: Nacht #08162F, Blauw #234AD3, Lime #D6F249, Wit #F7F9FC. Predominantly deep midnight and rich blue; decisive lime logo/detail accents, white text. No magenta/cyan colour pair.
Graphic language: three offset horizontal pixel lanes, crisp leading bars dissolving into dense small square blocks, aligned diagonal acceleration across the page. A large angular R-derived elbow, not generic wavy ribbons. Vector-like flat blue/lime bands plus finely pixelated wake. Technical diagram-like clarity with controlled dynamic asymmetry.
Layout: large broad logo and campaign along upper half; narrow vertical colour/typography rail on right; staggered application strip below, large graphic-language panel central. Do NOT replicate source grid exactly. Photograph a female entrepreneur and male adviser collaborating at a bright industrial design studio, paperwork and laptop; a second close-up of hands reviewing a proposal. No source couple repeated. Deep-blue website/app and bold lime-on-blue proposal.

variants.label: PULSE 01 / FLOW — WIT
variants.description: De bestaande Flow-richting op wit, met hetzelfde logo en dezelfde magenta/cyaan pixeltaal. Een directe vergelijking met de donkere uitvoering.
variants.prompt:
Edit the supplied PULSE 01 / FLOW moodboard into a precise WHITE-BACKGROUND VERSION labelled "PULSE 01 / FLOW — WIT". Keep the existing logo geometry, human photo, entire grid and full branding content as closely as possible. Change dark presentation fields, campaign, website, mobile UI and proposal to clean white or very light grey. At least 75% of board background is white. Wordmark and text become near-black, square i dot stays magenta. Preserve the SAME integrated six-letter revive with route R as letter one followed by evive, same geometry in every small/mono/reverse specimen and app icon. Small reversed-logo panel may remain black.
Keep the distinctive magenta/cyan TWO sweeping pixel channels, square-pixel details and fast directional dissolution. Rebalance pixel density so saturated pink/cyan trails read clearly on white; no pastel wash. Colours labelled: Wit #FFFFFF, Carbon #080A0D, Magenta #ED28B9, Cyaan #40BED8. Dark body/headline text for legibility; cyan only decorative/icon accents. Do not redesign the logo or introduce another slogan.

Both slogans verbatim, clearly readable in black with controlled magenta emphasis:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."
No other marketing copy or claims. No cars or automotive content. Landscape 1536x1024, clean premium finance identity with crisp pixel energy and strong white-background readability.
